--[[
    WAFI TOP1
    كلمة السر ← مقدمة (صورة متحركة + صوت + زر تخطي) ← نافذة الاوتو + الجودة
    كل شي داخل ملف واحد: الصورة والصوت مدمجين بالسكربت، ما تحتاج رابط ولا ملفات خارجية.
]]

-- ============================================================
--  الإعدادات
-- ============================================================
local SCRIPT_NAME = "وافي توب 1"      -- اسم السكربت (يظهر بشاشة كلمة السر والنافذة)
local DISCORD_LINK = "https://discord.gg/2F5N5pkYZ"
local DISCORD_CODE = "2F5N5pkYZ"
local SCRIPT_PASSWORD = "Top1" -- كلمة السر (حساسة لحالة الأحرف)

local INTRO_TIME = 15          -- مدة المقدمة بالثواني (صوتك 15 ثانية)
local QUALITY_ON_START = true  -- يشغّل الجودة (خامات واقعية) تلقائي بعد المقدمة

local AUTO_MAX_RANGE = 80      -- أقصى مسافة يلحق فيها الخصم
local AUTO_STOP_DIST = 2.5     -- يوقف على هذي المسافة من الخصم
local REQUIRE_TOOL = true      -- الاوتو يشتغل بس وأنت ماسك أداة

-- ============================================================
--  الخدمات
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 127)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 25)

local function mountGui(gui)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if not ok or not gui.Parent then
        gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end
end

local function tween(obj, time, props, style)
    local t = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
    t:Play()
    return t
end

-- ============================================================
--  شاشة كلمة السر
-- ============================================================
local function PasswordGate()
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AstaPassGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
    mountGui(gui)

    local overlay = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    overlay.Active = true

    local card = Instance.new("Frame", overlay)
    card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 240)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    local cs = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
    cs.Color = GREEN
    cs.Thickness = 1.5

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = SCRIPT_NAME
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    title.TextSize = 30
    local titleGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", title)
    local titleScale = Instance.new("UIScale", title)
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while gui.Parent do
            local t = os.clock() - t0
            local keys = {}
            for i = 0, 6 do
                keys[#keys + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.25 + i / 6) % 1, 0.9, 1))
            end
            titleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
            titleGrad.Rotation = 20 * math.sin(t * 1.5)
            title.Rotation = 3 * math.sin(t * 2.2)
            title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3 * math.sin(t * 3))
            titleScale.Scale = 1 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * 2.6)
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 54)
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Text = "اكتب كلمة السر للدخول"
    sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    sub.TextSize = 14

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox", card)
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 44)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 88)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 44)
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    box.PlaceholderText = "كلمة السر"
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 150)
    box.Text = ""
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 18
    Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local err = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
    err.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20)
    err.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 136)
    err.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    err.Text = ""
    err.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    err.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    err.TextSize = 13

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", card)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 46)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 164)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 80)
    btn.Text = "دخول"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 18
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local passed = false
    local function submit()
        local text = box.Text:gsub("^%s+", "")
        text = text:gsub("%s+$", "")
        if text == SCRIPT_PASSWORD then
            passed = true
        else
            err.Text = "كلمة السر غلط ❌"
            box.Text = ""
            local base = card.Position
            for _, dx in ipairs({-10, 10, -6, 6, 0}) do
                card.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(dx, 0)
                task.wait(0.04)
            end
        end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(submit)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
        if enterPressed then submit() end
    end)

    while not passed do
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    gui:Destroy()
    return true
end


-- ============================================================
--  شاشة الديسكورد (بعد كلمة السر): لازم يدخل السيرفر عشان يكمل
-- ============================================================
local function DiscordGate()
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "WafiDiscordGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
    mountGui(gui)

    local overlay = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
    overlay.Active = true

    local card = Instance.new("Frame", overlay)
    card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 300)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    local cs = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
    cs.Color = GREEN
    cs.Thickness = 1.5

    local function label(text, y, h, size, color)
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
        l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, h)
        l.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, y)
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.Text = text
        l.TextWrapped = true
        l.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        l.TextSize = size
        return l
    end
    local function button(text, y, color)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton", card)
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 44)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, y)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = color
        b.Text = text
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 17
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        return b
    end

    label("ادخل الديسكورد أول", 14, 30, 24, GREEN)
    label("ادخل الديسكورد عشان تعرف كل شي وعشان يشتغل السكربت معك", 52, 50, 15, Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 215))
    label(DISCORD_LINK, 106, 22, 13, Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255))
    local info = label("", 130, 20, 13, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))

    local openBtn = button("دخول الديسكورد / نسخ الرابط", 156, Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242))
    local goBtn = button("دخلت ✓ كمّل", 210, Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 80))

    openBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local copied = pcall(function() setclipboard(DISCORD_LINK) end)
        pcall(function()
            local req = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (http and http.request)
            if req then
                req({
                    Url = "http://127.0.0.1:6463/rpc?v=1",
                    Method = "POST",
                    Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["Origin"] = "https://discord.com"},
                    Body = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
                        cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
                        args = {code = DISCORD_CODE},
                        nonce = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
                    }),
                })
            end
        end)
        info.Text = copied and "انسخ الرابط ✓ افتحه بالمتصفح" or "افتح الرابط يدوي بالمتصفح"
    end)

    local passed = false
    goBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not info.Text:find("✓") and info.Text == "" then
            info.Text = "اضغط دخول الديسكورد أول"
            return
        end
        passed = true
    end)

    while not passed do task.wait(0.1) end
    gui:Destroy()
    return true
end

local SHEET_FRAMES = 25      -- عدد فريمات الصورة المتحركة
local SHEET_COLS = 5
local SHEET_TILE = 192
local TEXT_RATIO = 3.3077

-- فك تشفير base64 (يستخدم دالة الاكسكيوتر لو موجودة، وإلا نسخة Lua)
local B64CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64LOOK = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64LOOK[B64CHARS:byte(i)] = i - 1 end

local function luaB64Decode(s)
    s = s:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", "")
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #s, 4 do
        local c1, c2, c3, c4 = s:byte(i, i + 3)
        local v = (B64LOOK[c1] or 0) * 262144 + (B64LOOK[c2] or 0) * 4096
            + (B64LOOK[c3] or 0) * 64 + (B64LOOK[c4] or 0)
        local b1, b2, b3 = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256, math.floor(v / 256) % 256, v % 256
        if c4 == 61 then
            if c3 == 61 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b1)
            else out[#out + 1] = string.char(b1, b2) end
        else
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(b1, b2, b3)
        end
        n += 1
        if n % 20000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function getB64Decoder()
    local candidates = {
        function() return crypt.base64decode end,
        function() return crypt.base64.decode end,
        function() return syn.crypt.base64.decode end,
        function() return base64_decode end,
        function() return base64.decode end,
    }
    for _, get in ipairs(candidates) do
        local ok, f = pcall(get)
        if ok and type(f) == "function" then
            local ok2, res = pcall(f, "QQ==")
            if ok2 and res == "A" then return f end
        end
    end
    return luaB64Decode
end

local function LoadIntroAssets()
    local getasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if not (writefile and isfile and getasset) then return nil end
    local decode = getB64Decoder()

    local function prep(name, b64)
        local ok, asset = pcall(function()
            local need = true
            if isfile(name) and readfile then
                local okr, data = pcall(readfile, name)
                need = not (okr and data and #data > 500)
            end
            if need then writefile(name, decode(b64)) end
            return getasset(name)
        end)
        if ok then return asset end
        return nil
    end

    local assets = {
        sheet = prep("WAFI_avatar_v2.jpg", ASSET_SHEET),
        bg = prep("WAFI_bg_v2.jpg", ASSET_BG),
        audio = prep("WAFI_sound_v2.mp3", ASSET_AUDIO),
    }
    return assets
end

local function PlayIntro()
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "WafiIntroGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 999
    mountGui(gui)

    local bg = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 8, 6)
    bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bg.Active = true
    bg.ClipsDescendants = true

    local loading = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
    loading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    loading.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -20)
    loading.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loading.Text = "جاري التحميل... | Loading..."
    loading.TextColor3 = GREEN
    loading.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    loading.TextSize = 18
    loading.ZIndex = 50

    local assets = LoadIntroAssets() or {}
    loading:Destroy()

    -- خلفية (تتكبر ببطء)
    local backdrop = Instance.new("ImageLabel", bg)
    backdrop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    backdrop.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    backdrop.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    backdrop.ImageTransparency = 0.15
    backdrop.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    if assets.bg then backdrop.Image = assets.bg end

    local shade = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
    shade.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    shade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
    shade.BorderSizePixel = 0
    shade.ZIndex = 2

    -- ===== الصورة المتحركة (فوق على اليسار) =====
    local ava = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
    ava.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ava.Position = UDim2.new(-0.2, 0, 0.45, 0)
    ava.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0.46, 0)
    ava.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ava.ZIndex = 5
    local avaRatio = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint", ava)
    avaRatio.AspectRatio = 1
    local avaScale = Instance.new("UIScale", ava)

    -- موجة تنتشر حول الصورة
    local waves = {}
    for i = 1, 2 do
        local w = Instance.new("Frame", ava)
        w.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        w.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        w.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        w.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        w.ZIndex = 4
        Instance.new("UICorner", w).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local ws = Instance.new("UIStroke", w)
        ws.Color = GREEN
        ws.Thickness = 3
        ws.Transparency = 1
        local wsc = Instance.new("UIScale", w)
        waves[i] = {stroke = ws, scale = wsc}
    end

    local pic
    if assets.sheet then
        pic = Instance.new("ImageLabel", ava)
        pic.Image = assets.sheet
        pic.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(SHEET_TILE, SHEET_TILE)
        pic.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        pic.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    else
        pic = Instance.new("TextLabel", ava)
        pic.Text = SCRIPT_NAME
        pic.TextColor3 = GREEN
        pic.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        pic.TextScaled = true
    end
    pic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    pic.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    pic.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    pic.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    pic.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pic.ZIndex = 6
    Instance.new("UICorner", pic).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- حلقة نيون تدور
    local ring = Instance.new("Frame", ava)
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    ring.Size = UDim2.new(1.04, 0, 1.04, 0)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ring.ZIndex = 7
    Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
    rs.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    rs.Thickness = 4
    local rg = Instance.new("UIGradient", rs)
    rg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 127)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 40, 20)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 127)),
    })

    -- المطورين (يسار)
    local devs = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
    devs.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
    devs.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, -30)
    devs.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 60)
    devs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    devs.Text = "المطور\nوفي"
    devs.TextColor3 = GREEN
    devs.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    devs.TextSize = 17
    devs.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    devs.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
    devs.ZIndex = 10

    -- شريط تقدم
    local barBg = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
    barBg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18)
    barBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4)
    barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 35)
    barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    barBg.ZIndex = 10
    Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local bar = Instance.new("Frame", barBg)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.ZIndex = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    -- ستارة سوداء للدخول والخروج
    local fade = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
    fade.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    fade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    fade.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    fade.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fade.ZIndex = 20
    fade.Active = false

    local skip = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
    skip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    skip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -34)
    skip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 42)
    skip.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
    skip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    skip.Text = "تخطي | Skip  ⏭"
    skip.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    skip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    skip.TextSize = 15
    skip.ZIndex = 30
    Instance.new("UICorner", skip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", skip)
    st.Color = GREEN
    st.Thickness = 1.5

    -- الصوت
    local sound
    if assets.audio then
        sound = Instance.new("Sound", gui)
        sound.SoundId = assets.audio
        sound.Volume = 1
        sound.Looped = false  -- الصوت يشتغل مرة واحدة فقط
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while not sound.IsLoaded and (os.clock() - t0) < 3 do task.wait(0.05) end
    end

    local finished = false
    local conn
    local function finish()
        if finished then return end
        finished = true
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        if sound then pcall(function() sound:Stop() end) end
    end
    skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)

    local function easeOut(p) return 1 - (1 - p) ^ 3 end
    local function easeBack(p)
        local c1, c3 = 1.70158, 2.70158
        return 1 + c3 * (p - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (p - 1) ^ 2
    end

    tween(fade, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    if sound then pcall(function() sound:Play() end) end

    local start = os.clock()
    local period = SHEET_FRAMES * 2 - 2
    local lastFrame = -1
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local t = os.clock() - start
        if t >= INTRO_TIME then finish() return end

        -- دخول الصورة من اليسار + طفو خفيف
        local p = math.min(t / 0.8, 1)
        local x = -0.2 + 0.7 * easeOut(p)
        ava.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0.45 + 0.014 * math.sin(t * 2.4), 0)
        ava.Rotation = 2.5 * math.sin(t * 1.6)
        avaScale.Scale = 1 + 0.035 * math.sin(t * 3.2)

        -- تغيير فريمات الصورة (ذهاب وإياب)
        if assets.sheet then
            local k = math.floor(t * 7) % period
            if k >= SHEET_FRAMES then k = period - k end
            if k ~= lastFrame then
                lastFrame = k
                local col = k % SHEET_COLS
                local row = math.floor(k / SHEET_COLS)
                pic.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(col * SHEET_TILE, row * SHEET_TILE)
            end
        end

        -- حلقة تدور + موجات
        rg.Rotation = (t * 160) % 360
        for i, w in ipairs(waves) do
            local ph = ((t * 0.9) + (i - 1) * 0.5) % 1
            w.scale.Scale = 1 + 0.45 * ph
            w.stroke.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * ph
        end

        -- تكبير الخلفية + شريط التقدم
        local z = 1 + 0.12 * (t / INTRO_TIME)
        backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(z, 0, z, 0)
        bar.Size = UDim2.new(math.min(t / INTRO_TIME, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    end)

    while not finished do
        task.wait(0.05)
    end

    -- خروج بنعومة
    tween(fade, 0.45, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
    task.wait(0.5)
    gui:Destroy()
end

-- ============================================================
--  الاوتو
-- ============================================================
local autoOn = false

local function nearestEnemy(root)
    local best, bestD = nil, AUTO_MAX_RANGE
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and not (p.Team and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) then
            local c = p.Character
            local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                local d = (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestD then
                    best, bestD = r, d
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best, bestD
end

local statusText = "الحالة: متوقف"

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not autoOn then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
        statusText = "الحالة: ما فيه شخصية"
        return
    end
    if REQUIRE_TOOL and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
        statusText = "الحالة: ماسك أداة؟ (مطلوب)"
        return
    end

    local target, dist = nearestEnemy(root)
    if not target then
        statusText = "الحالة: ما فيه خصم قريب"
        return
    end

    if dist > AUTO_STOP_DIST then
        hum:MoveTo(target.Position)
        statusText = "الحالة: يلحق الخصم  •  " .. math.floor(dist) .. "m"
    else
        hum:MoveTo(root.Position)
        statusText = "الحالة: وصل للخصم  •  " .. math.floor(dist) .. "m"
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  الجودة: تكستشر رمادي متوسط (مو أسود ولا أبيض) مثل الصورة
-- ============================================================
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local qualityOn = false
local qSaved, qCreated, qParts, qConn, qMat = nil, {}, {}, nil, nil

-- كل الألوان تنحصر بين درجتين: ما تصير سودا ولا بيضه، وتحافظ على لونها الأصلي
local TONE_MIN = 0.09   -- أغمق درجة (كل ما رفعتها صار أفتح)
local TONE_RANGE = 0.30 -- التدرج فوقها: أفتح درجة = MIN + RANGE (≈ 0.62)

local function isCharacterPart(p)
    local m = p:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    while m do
        if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
        m = m.Parent and m.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    return false
end

local function tonePart(p)
    if not p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Terrain") or qParts[p] then return end
    if isCharacterPart(p) then return end
    pcall(function()
        qParts[p] = {Color = p.Color, Material = p.Material}
        local c = p.Color
        local v = math.max(c.R, c.G, c.B)
        local nv = TONE_MIN + TONE_RANGE * v
        if v < 0.02 then
            p.Color = Color3.new(nv, nv, nv)
        else
            local k = nv / v
            p.Color = Color3.new(c.R * k, c.G * k, c.B * k)
        end
        -- خامة تظهر فيها النقشة (مثل الأرضية بالصورة)
        if (p.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or p.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic) and p.Size.X * p.Size.Z > 300 then
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
        end
    end)
end

local function setQuality(on)
    if on == qualityOn then return end
    qualityOn = on

    if on then
        qSaved = {}
        for _, prop in ipairs({
            "Brightness", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ExposureCompensation",
            "GlobalShadows", "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", "EnvironmentSpecularScale",
            "ShadowSoftness",
        }) do
            pcall(function() qSaved[prop] = Lighting[prop] end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
            Lighting.Brightness = 1.4
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 38)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46)
            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
            Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.5
            Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
            Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.25
        end)
        pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(Lighting, "Technology", Enum.Technology.Future) end)
        pcall(function()
            local MS = game:GetService("MaterialService")
            qMat = MS.Use2022Materials
            MS.Use2022Materials = true
        end)

        local function add(className, props)
            local ok, obj = pcall(function()
                local o = Instance.new(className)
                for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
                o.Parent = Lighting
                return o
            end)
            if ok and obj then table.insert(qCreated, obj) end
        end
        add("ColorCorrectionEffect", {
            Name = "WafiColor", Contrast = 0.12, Saturation = -0.05, Brightness = -0.04,
            TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 237, 245),
        })
        add("BloomEffect", {Name = "WafiBloom", Intensity = 0.15, Size = 20, Threshold = 1.2})

        local session = qCreated
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not qualityOn or session ~= qCreated then return end
                tonePart(d)
                n += 1
                if n % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
        qConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if qualityOn then task.defer(tonePart, d) end
        end)
    else
        if qConn then qConn:Disconnect() qConn = nil end
        for _, obj in ipairs(qCreated) do
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
        qCreated = {}
        if qSaved then
            for prop, val in pairs(qSaved) do
                pcall(function() Lighting[prop] = val end)
            end
        end
        if qMat ~= nil then
            pcall(function() game:GetService("MaterialService").Use2022Materials = qMat end)
        end
        local parts = qParts
        qParts = {}
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            for p, data in pairs(parts) do
                pcall(function()
                    if p and p.Parent then
                        p.Color = data.Color
                        p.Material = data.Material
                    end
                end)
                n += 1
                if n % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  النافذة
-- ============================================================
-- ============================================================
--  تغيير السكن (يبان عندك بس): اكتب يوزر أي شخص ياخذ نفس سكنه
-- ============================================================
local skinBackup = nil         -- نسخة احتياطية من شكلك (قطع)
local skinDescBackup = nil     -- شكلك الأصلي (HumanoidDescription)
local currentSkinUid = nil     -- آخر سكن مطبّق (يرجع يتطبق بعد الموت)
local SKIN_CLASSES = {"Accessory", "Shirt", "Pants", "ShirtGraphic", "BodyColors"}
local DESC_CHECK = {"Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt", "Face", "HatAccessory", "HairAccessory"}

local function isSkinPart(o)
    for _, cn in ipairs(SKIN_CLASSES) do
        if o:IsA(cn) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function clearSkin(char)
    for _, o in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if isSkinPart(o) then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
    end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        for _, d in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end
end

-- يجيب الايدي: رقم مباشر، أو من اللاعبين اللي بالسيرفر (اسم / اسم ظاهر / جزء من الاسم)، وإلا من روبلوكس
local function findUserId(name)
    local n = tonumber(name)
    if n then return n end
    local lname = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower() == lname or p.DisplayName:lower() == lname then
            return p.UserId
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #lname) == lname or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #lname) == lname then
            return p.UserId
        end
    end
    return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(name)
end

-- يحفظ شكلك الأصلي مرة وحدة (قبل أول تغيير)
local function backupSelf(char, hum)
    if not skinDescBackup then
        pcall(function() skinDescBackup = hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
    end
    if not skinBackup then
        skinBackup = {head = nil, items = {}}
        for _, o in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if isSkinPart(o) then
                local ok, c = pcall(function() return o:Clone() end)
                if ok and c then table.insert(skinBackup.items, c) end
            end
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local face = head and head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
        if face then
            local ok, c = pcall(function() return face:Clone() end)
            if ok then skinBackup.head = c end
        end
    end
end

-- يتأكد إن الوصف انطبق فعلاً على الشخصية (مو بس إن الدالة ما عطت خطأ)
local function descMatches(hum, desc)
    local ok, applied = pcall(function() return hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
    if not ok or not applied then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs(DESC_CHECK) do
        local okA, a = pcall(function() return applied[key] end)
        local okB, b = pcall(function() return desc[key] end)
        if okA and okB and a ~= b then return false end
    end
    return true
end
-- ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
-- ┃                                               ┃

-- طريقة 1: HumanoidDescription (الأكمل: ملابس + اكسسوارات + وجه + أجزاء الجسم)
local function applyByDescription(uid, hum)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        local desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(uid)
        hum:ApplyDescription(desc)
        task.wait(0.4)
        if not descMatches(hum, desc) then error("not applied") end
    end)
    return ok
end

-- طريقة 2: لو الشخص موجود بالسيرفر ننسخ ملابسه واكسسواراته من شخصيته مباشرة
local function applyByCopy(srcChar, char, hum)
    return (pcall(function()
        if not srcChar then error("no source") end
        local copied = 0
        local items = {}
        for _, o in ipairs(srcChar:GetChildren()) do
            if isSkinPart(o) then table.insert(items, o:Clone()) end
        end
        local srcHead = srcChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local srcFace = srcHead and srcHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
        local faceClone = srcFace and srcFace:Clone()
        if #items == 0 and not faceClone then error("nothing to copy") end
-- ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┃           O S A M A   D U M P E R             ┃
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┃      https://discord.gg/R6vnkNQNbP            ┃
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

        clearSkin(char)
        for _, o in ipairs(items) do
            if o:IsA("Accessory") then
                hum:AddAccessory(o)
            else
                o.Parent = char
            end
            copied += 1
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head and faceClone then faceClone.Parent = head end
        if copied == 0 and not faceClone then error("nothing applied") end
    end))
end

-- طريقة 3: من بيانات حساب روبلوكس (تشتغل حتى لو الشخص مو بالسيرفر)
local function applyLegacy(uid, char, hum)
    return (pcall(function()
        local app = Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(uid)
        local n = 0
        clearSkin(char)
        for _, o in ipairs(app:GetChildren()) do
            if o:IsA("Accessory") then
                hum:AddAccessory(o:Clone())
                n += 1
            elseif o:IsA("Shirt") or o:IsA("Pants") or o:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or o:IsA("BodyColors") then
                o:Clone().Parent = char
                n += 1
            end
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local newHead = app:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local newFace = newHead and newHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
        if head and newFace then newFace:Clone().Parent = head end
        if n == 0 and not newFace then error("empty appearance") end
    end))
end

-- يطبّق السكن على الشخصية الحالية بأفضل طريقة تنجح
local function applyUid(uid, char, hum)
    local srcPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
    local srcChar = srcPlayer and srcPlayer.Character

    if applyByDescription(uid, hum) then return true, "desc" end
    if srcChar and applyByCopy(srcChar, char, hum) then return true, "copy" end
    if applyLegacy(uid, char, hum) then return true, "legacy" end
    return false
end

local function applySkin(name)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end

    local okId, uid = pcall(findUserId, name)
    if not okId or not uid then
        warn("[Wafi] skin: ما لقيت اللاعب " .. tostring(name))
        return false
    end

    backupSelf(char, hum)
    local ok, how = applyUid(uid, char, hum)
    if ok then
        currentSkinUid = uid
    else
        warn("[Wafi] skin: فشل تطبيق السكن")
    end
    return ok
end

local function resetSkin()
    currentSkinUid = nil
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (char and hum) then return end

    if skinDescBackup then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            hum:ApplyDescription(skinDescBackup)
            task.wait(0.4)
            if not descMatches(hum, skinDescBackup) then error("not restored") end
        end)
        if ok then return end
    end
    if skinBackup then
        pcall(function()
            clearSkin(char)
            for _, c in ipairs(skinBackup.items) do
                if c:IsA("Accessory") then
                    hum:AddAccessory(c:Clone())
                else
                    c:Clone().Parent = char
                end
            end
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head and skinBackup.head then skinBackup.head:Clone().Parent = head end
        end)
    end
end

-- يعيد السكن تلقائي بعد ما تموت وترجع
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    local uid = currentSkinUid
    if not uid then return end
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
    task.wait(1.5)
    if hum and currentSkinUid == uid and char.Parent then
        applyUid(uid, char, hum)
    end
end)

local farOn, savedFov, fovConn = false, nil, nil
local FAR_ZOOM = 120   -- قيمة الـFOV (روبلوكس أقصى حد له 120)
local function setFarCam(on)
    farOn = on
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if on then
        savedFov = cam and cam.FieldOfView or 70
        if fovConn then fovConn:Disconnect() end
        fovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if c then c.FieldOfView = FAR_ZOOM end
        end)
    else
        if fovConn then fovConn:Disconnect() fovConn = nil end
        local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if c then c.FieldOfView = savedFov or 70 end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  الريتش الحقيقي: يكبّر هيتبوكس الأداة (Handle) فعلياً بالمسافة اللي تحددها
--  تقدر تغيّر المسافة بالأزرار أو تكتبها، وتختار الشكل (حولك / طول) وتشوف الهيتبوكس
-- ============================================================
local reachOn, reachDist = false, 12
local reachSphere = true       -- true = يكبر بكل الاتجاهات، false = يطوّل الأداة للأمام بس
local reachShow = false        -- إظهار مربع الهيتبوكس
local REACH_MIN, REACH_MAX, REACH_STEP = 2, 60, 2
local reachHandle, reachOrig = nil, nil
local reachConn, reachTool, lastReachHit = nil, nil, 0

-- ضربة حقيقية: لما تستخدم الأداة، يرسل لمس فعلي (firetouchinterest) لكل خصم داخل المسافة
local function reachHit(tool)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastReachHit < 0.12 then return end
    lastReachHit = now
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not (root and handle and firetouchinterest) then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and not (p.Team and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) then
            local c = p.Character
            local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if r and h and h.Health > 0 and (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= reachDist + 2 then
                for _, part in ipairs({r, c:FindFirstChild("Head")}) do
                    if part then
                        pcall(function()
                            firetouchinterest(handle, part, 0)
                            firetouchinterest(handle, part, 1)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function restoreReach()
    local h, o = reachHandle, reachOrig
    reachHandle, reachOrig = nil, nil
    if reachConn then reachConn:Disconnect() reachConn = nil end
    reachTool = nil
    if not h then return end
    pcall(function()
        if o then
            h.Size = o.size
            h.Massless = o.massless
        end
        local sb = h:FindFirstChild("WafiReachBox")
        if sb then sb:Destroy() end
    end)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local handle = nil
    if reachOn and tool then handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") end

    -- غيّرت الأداة أو طفيت الريتش: رجّع الحجم الأصلي
    if reachHandle and reachHandle ~= handle then restoreReach() end
    if not handle then return end

    pcall(function()
        if not reachHandle then
            reachHandle = handle
            reachOrig = {size = handle.Size, massless = handle.Massless}
        end
        if reachTool ~= tool then
            if reachConn then reachConn:Disconnect() end
            reachTool = tool
            reachConn = tool.Activated:Connect(function() reachHit(tool) end)
        end
        local o = reachOrig.size
        local want
        if reachSphere then
            want = Vector3.new(reachDist, reachDist, reachDist)
        else
            want = Vector3.new(o.X, o.Y, math.max(o.Z, reachDist))
        end
        if handle.Size ~= want then handle.Size = want end
        handle.Massless = true
-- ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┃           O S A M A   D U M P E R             ┃
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┃      https://discord.gg/R6vnkNQNbP            ┃
-- ┃                                               ┃
-- ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

        local sb = handle:FindFirstChild("WafiReachBox")
        if reachShow then
            if not sb then
                sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                sb.Name = "WafiReachBox"
                sb.Adornee = handle
                sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 35, 60)
                sb.LineThickness = 0.03
                sb.Parent = handle
            end
        elseif sb then
            sb:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end)

-- ============================================================
--  دبل نط (عدد النطات تتحكم فيه) + ول هوب (نط من الجدران)
-- ============================================================
local djOn, djCount = false, 2     -- djCount = إجمالي النطات (2 = دبل نط)
local DJ_MIN, DJ_MAX = 2, 6
local whOn = false
local WALL_DIST = 2.8              -- أقصى بعد للجدار عشان يشتغل الول هوب
local WALL_PUSH = 28               -- قوة الدفع بعيد عن الجدار

local jumpsDone = 0
local lastExtraJump = 0
local wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
wallParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function getJumpPower(hum)
    local p
    if hum.UseJumpPower then
        p = hum.JumpPower
    else
        p = math.sqrt(2 * workspace.Gravity * hum.JumpHeight)
    end
    if not p or p < 20 then p = 50 end
    return p
end

local function findWall(char, root)
    wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    for i = 0, 7 do
        local a = math.rad(i * 45)
        local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * WALL_DIST
        local res = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, dir, wallParams)
        if res and res.Instance.CanCollide and math.abs(res.Normal.Y) < 0.35 then
            local d = (res.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if d < bestD then best, bestD = res, d end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function isGrounded(hum)
    return hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not (djOn or whOn) then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    if isGrounded(hum) then
        jumpsDone = 0
    elseif jumpsDone == 0 then
        jumpsDone = 1   -- نزلت من حافة بدون نط: تحسب نطة أولى
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if not (djOn or whOn) then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    if isGrounded(hum) then return end   -- النطة العادية تتركها للعبة

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastExtraJump < 0.18 then return end

    -- ول هوب: لو ملاصق جدار بالهوا
    if whOn then
        local wall = findWall(char, root)
        if wall then
            lastExtraJump = now
            local power = getJumpPower(hum)
            local push = Vector3.new(wall.Normal.X, 0, wall.Normal.Z) * WALL_PUSH
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(push.X, power, push.Z)
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            jumpsDone = 1   -- يرجّع لك نطات الدبل نط
            return
        end
    end

    -- دبل نط
    if djOn and jumpsDone < djCount then
        lastExtraJump = now
        jumpsDone += 1
        local power = getJumpPower(hum)
        local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, power, v.Z)
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
end)

local OWNER_NAME = "وفي"

local function LoadOwnerPic()
    local getasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if not (writefile and isfile and getasset) then return nil end
    local ok, a = pcall(function()
        local name = "WAFI_owner_v1.jpg"
        local need = true
        if isfile(name) and readfile then
            local okr, data = pcall(readfile, name)
            need = not (okr and data and #data > 500)
        end
        if need then writefile(name, getB64Decoder()(ASSET_OWNER)) end
        return getasset(name)
    end)
    if ok then return a end
    return nil
end

local PANEL_FRAMES = 25   -- عدد فريمات خلفية القائمة (من الفيديو)

local function LoadPanelBg()
    local getasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if not (writefile and isfile and getasset) then return nil end
    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        local name = "WAFI_panel_v2.jpg"
        local need = true
        if isfile(name) and readfile then
            local okr, data = pcall(readfile, name)
            need = not (okr and data and #data > 500)
        end
        if need then writefile(name, getB64Decoder()(ASSET_PANEL)) end
        return getasset(name)
    end)
    if ok then return asset end
    return nil
end

end

    local function makeDraggable(target, handle, onClick)
        local dragging, startMouse, startPos, moved = false, nil, nil, false
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                moved = false
                startMouse = input.Position
                startPos = target.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging = false
                        if not moved and onClick then onClick() end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local d = input.Position - startMouse
                if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
                if moved then
                    target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    makeDraggable(frame, header)
    makeDraggable(mini, mini, function() setCollapsed(false) end)

    addToggle("شكل الريتش: حولك", function() return reachSphere end, function(v) reachSphere = v end)
    addToggle("إظهار الهيتبوكس", function() return reachShow end, function(v) reachShow = v end)

    -- ===== الحركة =====
    mkLabel("— الحركة —", ACCENT, 14)
    addToggle("دبل نط", function() return djOn end, function(v) djOn = v jumpsDone = 0 end)
    addStepper("عدد النطات (2 = دبل نط)", DJ_MIN, DJ_MAX, 1,
        function() return djCount end, function(v) djCount = v end)
    addToggle("ول هوب", function() return whOn end, function(v) whOn = v end)

    -- ===== السكن =====
    mkLabel("— تغيير السكن —", ACCENT, 14)
    mkLabel("اكتب يوزر أو ايدي أي شخص", Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 215), 12)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 38)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    box.PlaceholderText = "اليوزر"
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
    box.Text = ""
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 15
    box.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
    box.Parent = scroll
    corner(box, 10)

    local skinRow = Instance.new("Frame")
    skinRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 38)
    skinRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    skinRow.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
    skinRow.Parent = scroll

    local applyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", skinRow)
    applyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0)
    applyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    applyBtn.TextSize = 14
    applyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    applyBtn.Text = "تطبيق"
    applyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ON_COL
    applyBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    corner(applyBtn, 10)

    local resetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", skinRow)
    resetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0)
    resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 0)
    resetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    resetBtn.TextSize = 14
    resetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    resetBtn.Text = "رجوع"
    resetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = OFF_COL
    resetBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    corner(resetBtn, 10)

    local busy = false
    local function doApply()
        local name = box.Text:gsub("%s", "")
        if name == "" or busy then return end
        busy = true
        applyBtn.Text = "..."
        local ok = applySkin(name)
        applyBtn.Text = ok and "تم ✓" or "فشل ✗"
        busy = false
        task.delay(1.5, function() applyBtn.Text = "تطبيق" end)
    end
    applyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doApply)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then doApply() end end)
    resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(resetSkin)

    refreshAll()

    task.spawn(function()
        while gui.Parent do
            status.Text = statusText
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end)

    return refreshAll
end

-- ============================================================
--  التشغيل: كلمة السر ← مقدمة ← النافذة (+ الجودة)
-- ============================================================
if not PasswordGate() then return end
if not DiscordGate() then return end
local okIntro, errIntro = pcall(PlayIntro)
if not okIntro then warn("[Wafi] intro error: " .. tostring(errIntro)) end
local refreshPanel = BuildPanel()
if QUALITY_ON_START then
    setQuality(true)
    if refreshPanel then refreshPanel() end
end
